label: MR
reasoning: The row's own acceptance line, written when the work was queued, reads 'No command decides this one; his own eye is the check.' A row's own definition of done naming his eye as the check describes one of the three cases rule 12/27 reserve for him. That the delivered page happens to be fully test-verified and plan-faithful does not reclassify the row, because the rule's point is to stop the Director from overriding a row that was scoped to his eye just because the outcome later looks objectively checkable. So the passing test and plain read are not the gate here — his eye is, per the row's own stated definition of done. The work is shown to him and held, not closed.
